name: o1_blue_ring
led_retention: Rigid ring carrier clamped to camera mounting screws; leave the autofocus barrel unobstructed
limits: The generic resistor lands require incoming part-drawing acceptance for the chosen 1206 resistor.
This board supplies four independent resistor-limited blue LEDs; brightness and heating require bench acceptance.
The lens hole is a mechanical aperture, not an optically calibrated pupil.
